app.name: Coinroost
app.title: {page} · Coinroost
more.title: More
language.label: Language
login.title: Log in
login.code_hint: The 6 digits your authenticator app shows now.
login.wrong: The email, password or code is not right. Codes change every 30 seconds.
import.title: Import bank files
import.accounts_failed: The accounts could not be loaded
import.no_accounts: Each file goes into one of your accounts, and you have none yet.
import.choose_hint: Statements as the bank exports them (CSV, Excel or PDF), one or many at once. Nothing is imported until you confirm each file.
file.ambiguous: The file fits several accounts: choose one.
file.not_found: No account recognizes this file: choose one.
file.no_profile: Create an account with a bank profile first.
file.layout_one: 1 row belongs to the bank’s layout (a header, a total or the opening balance): it is not a transaction.
file.layout_other: {count} rows belong to the bank’s layout (headers, totals or the opening balance): they are not transactions.
file.nothing_new: Every row is already imported: there is nothing to add.
accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.create_failed: The account could not be created
accounts.name: Name
accounts.bank_file_hint: How this account's statements are read; none for cash.
accounts.key_hint: Goes into every imported transaction's id; it cannot change later.
accounts.markers_hint: Optional, comma separated: texts this account's files always contain.
accounts.prefixes_hint: Optional, for cards that share a format: 4 for Visa, 34, 37 for Amex.
coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.hint: Up to when each account has data, and what the imported files cover. Status **{check}**: more than 15 days without data; **{late}**: more than 40. A statement cycle is about 30 days, but a quiet account can be still on purpose.
uncategorized.title: Uncategorized
uncategorized.failed: The transactions could not be loaded
uncategorized.set_failed: The category could not be set
uncategorized.hint: Transactions no rule sorted. A category you choose here stays: rules never change it.
uncategorized.no_categories: You have no categories yet: create them to sort these transactions.
rules.title: Rules
rules.failed: The rules could not be loaded
rules.move_failed: The rule could not be moved
rules.delete_failed: The rule could not be deleted
rules.hint: The first rule, from the top, that matches a transaction sets its category and payee; the rules below it are not looked at.
then.payee_from_text: payee: the name after the text
ruleform.title: New rule
ruleform.hint: It goes last. It sorts files imported from now on; existing transactions change only when you check and apply below.
ruleform.name: Rule name
ruleform.text_hint: Upper or lower case alike; accents and spaces count.
ruleform.payee_from_text: The name after the text (a payment channel)
ruleform.bad_amount: Amounts are numbers with up to two decimals, such as 25 or 25.50.
ruleform.failed: The rule could not be created
categoryform.title: New category
categoryform.name: Category name
categoryform.failed: The category could not be created
changes.only_rule: Only the rule that set it changes
changes.check_failed: The changes could not be checked
changes.stale: The changes are not the ones you checked any more: check again.
changes.apply_failed: The rules could not be applied
changes.title: Apply the rules to existing transactions
changes.hint: See first what would change. A category or payee you chose by hand is never changed.
transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.failed: The transfers could not be loaded
transfers.hint: Money moved between your own accounts arrives twice, once with each statement. Paired, it is one transfer: the balances stay the same and it counts as neither spending nor income.
legs.pass_1: the only match within two days
legs.pass_3: sent on a Friday, arrived on Monday
legs.no_counterpart: No other side within two days: its statement may not be imported yet.
legs.ambiguous: Several legs could be its other side: choose one.
summary.failed: The summary could not be loaded
summary.title: Money in and out
summary.hint: Transfers between your accounts count in neither. Legs still waiting for their other side are shown apart.
summary.nothing: No money moved in this period.
waiting.stale: The pairs changed since this page loaded: they are shown again, check them.
waiting.failed: The pairs could not be made
waiting.title: Pairs waiting
waiting.nothing: Nothing waiting: imports pair what is certain on their own.
waiting.hint: Pairing changes no balance: the same two legs become one transfer.
waiting.drops_manual: Drops a category you chose for the incoming side
unmatched.failed: The two could not be paired
unmatched.title: Legs without a pair
unmatched.nothing: Every transfer leg has its other side.
unmatched.by_hand_hint: For a transfer that took longer than usual. The lists hold the transfer legs still waiting.
made.failed: The transfer could not be split
made.title: Transfers made
dashboard.title: Summary
dashboard.failed: The summary could not be loaded
dashboard.nothing: No money moved in this period.
dashboard.no_accounts: You have no accounts yet: each statement is imported into one.
chart.title: Income and spending per month
payroll.title: Payments owed to you
payroll.failed: What employers owe could not be loaded
payroll.as_of: As of {date}, with each account's data up to its latest statement.
payroll.no_data: No data yet for {fortnights}: the account has data up to {date}.
payroll.no_deposits: No deposit counted since {date}: check the match text, the account and the minimum amount.
setup.title: Set up your access
setup.invalid: It was used, it expired or it does not exist. Ask for a new one.
setup.to_login: Already have an account? Log in
setup.step_account: Step 1 of 3 · Your email and password
setup.password_hint: 12 characters or more. The Passwords app can create and save it.
setup.scan: Scan this code with your passwords or authenticator app.
setup.qr_alt: QR code to set up the verification code
setup.code_hint: The 6 digits the app shows now for this account.
setup.taken: A user with that email already exists.
setup.failed: Could not set up your access
setup.wrong_code: The code does not match. Wait for the next one (they change every 30 seconds) and try again.
auth.tagline: Your household's finances, on your own server.
login.subtitle: Email, password and the code from your app.
password.shown: The password is visible on screen
setup.first_lead: Coinroost has no accounts yet: yours will be the owner.
setup.scan_phone: On this phone, tap “Set up on this device” or copy the key; from another phone, scan the code.
setup.codes_lead: If you lose your phone, each code lets you in once. Keep them away from this phone: in a note in the Passwords app, or printed.
recovery.file_note: Each code logs you in once, in place of the app's code. Keep them away from your phone.
login.use_recovery: Lost your phone? Use a recovery code
login.recovery_hint: One of the 10 you saved, like abcde‑12345. Each works once.
login.recovery_wrong: The email, password or recovery code is not right.
authenticator.title: Set up your new authenticator
authenticator.lead: You came in with a recovery code, so your old authenticator stopped working. Add this one to your app and type the code it shows.
authenticator.failed: The authenticator could not be saved
security.title: Security
security.codes_about: They let you in if you lose your phone. Each works once, and after using one you set up a new authenticator.
security.codes_none: You have no recovery codes yet.
security.codes_low: Only a few left: make new ones.
security.regenerate_note: Type the code your app shows now. The old codes will stop working.
security.new_lead: Save them now: they are not shown again. The old ones no longer work.
security.locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
security.failed: The codes could not be made
security.load_failed: Your codes' status could not be read
form.email: Type an email address, like name@example.com.
form.format: This does not have the expected format.
problem.status_401: Your session ended: log in again.
problem.status_404: {what}: it is not there any more.
problem.status_412: Something changed in the meantime: look again and retry.
problem.status_422: {what}: check the values and try again.
problem.status_5xx: {what}: the server failed. Try again in a moment.
problem.already_exists: There is already one with this value: use another.
problem.already_exists.name: One already has this name: use another.
problem.already_exists.namespace: An account already has this key: use another.
problem.unknown_reference: It refers to something that no longer exists. Reload the page.
problem.out_of_range: A value is out of range.
problem.text_length: Type some text (not only spaces), within the length allowed.
problem.currency_unknown: Use a 3-letter currency code, like USD.
problem.namespace_format: Use lower-case letters, digits, “-” or “_”, starting with a letter or digit.
problem.unknown_profile: That bank file format does not exist.
problem.profile_currency_mismatch: That bank file is in another currency than the account.
problem.card_prefixes_format: Card prefixes are 1 to 6 digits each.
problem.number_hash_format: The account number check is not valid.
problem.wrong_code: That code does not match. Wait for the next one and try again.
problem.too_many_codes: Too many wrong codes: wait 15 minutes and try again.
problem.enrollment_changed: The authenticator changed: open the step again and scan it.
problem.reenroll_required: A recovery code was used: set up a new authenticator first.
problem.reenroll_not_needed: Your authenticator works; there is nothing to replace.
problem.already_set_up: This app already has an account: ask its owner for a setup link.
problem.code_or_recovery_code: Type the authenticator code or a recovery code.
problem.account_without_profile: This account has no bank file format: choose one in Accounts.
problem.currency_not_supported: Imports into this currency are not supported yet.
problem.file_too_long: The file has too many rows.
problem.file_unreadable: The file cannot be read with this account's bank format. Check it is the right statement.
problem.file_missing_columns: The file lacks columns this bank's format needs. Check it is the right statement.
problem.file_format_unsupported: This bank file format cannot be read yet.
problem.profile_invalid: The bank file format is broken; it needs a fix in the app.
problem.transfer_same_account: A transfer moves money between two different accounts.
problem.transfer_currencies_differ: A transfer moves money within one currency.
problem.transfer_not_balanced: Those two do not cancel out: one must leave an account and the other arrive with the same amount.
problem.not_single_leg: One of the two is already part of a transfer. Reload the page.
problem.not_a_transfer: Only a transfer can be split.
problem.split_transfer_first: This is a transfer: split it first, then delete either side.
problem.leg_count: A transaction has one side, or two for a transfer.
problem.unknown_account: That account does not exist any more. Reload the page.
problem.dates_reversed: The start date is after the end date.
problem.limit_out_of_range: Too many items asked for at once.
problem.payee_named_and_read: Choose a payee or read it from the text, not both.
problem.position_out_of_range: That position is outside the list.
problem.preview_outdated: The changes are not the ones you reviewed any more: review them again.
problem.preview_tag_required: Review the changes before applying them.
problem.first_account_from_console: The first account of this app is made from the server console.
problem.browser_not_allowed: A browser cannot use this address.
problem.rule_empty_text: The text to look for cannot be empty.
problem.rule_no_condition: A rule needs at least one condition: text, money in or out, an account or an amount.
problem.rule_negative_amount: Amounts in a rule are sizes: zero or more, without a sign.
problem.rule_nothing_to_set: A rule needs a category or a payee to set.
problem.rule_payee_text_missing: Reading the payee from the text needs the text the rule looks for.
row.unreadable_amount: No amount that can be read
